# Keystone Realty Advisor - extended notes

Keystone Realty Advisor is a real estate advisory and property consultancy. The website lists residential and commercial properties for sale and rent and publishes new-project pages for Delhi NCR.

## What the website offers
- Property listings for sale and rent, filterable by city, type, BHK, budget and furnishing.
- City pages for Delhi, Gurugram and Noida, and category pages such as 2/3/4 BHK flats, villas, builder floors and commercial property in the cities listed in the sitemap.
- New-project pages with configurations, amenities and floor plans where published.
- An enquiry form on every listing and on the contact page, plus phone and WhatsApp.
